description: Hand cases for the platformer.* rows (PL.native-genre-rows slice 2): what core's corpora conformance/platformer/ leave unpinned — the contract, junction atoms and labels, courseGraph, generateCourse and courseFromIR alone, the row's sections over a world's own, routes with modes and tuning, the stars at their edges, the save block's defaults and refusals, ids naming Object.prototype members, the [invalid-input] boundary of every argument, and directors over their own KB with and without the probe and locomotion hosts. Every expectation is computed by core's own functions at the pin (gen-bridge-platformer-cases.mts, kept with the builder's record).
